description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data across various categories within the MMRA benchmark, which evaluates multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each representing a different category with its corresponding count and percentage of the total. The largest segment is "ObservationAngle" with 126 instances (12.28%), followed by "SimilarMaterial" with 106 instances (10.33%). Other notable segments include "SubEvent" and "UsageSimilarity," each with 100 instances (9.74% and 9.65%, respectively). The remaining categories—"NearSameEntity," "RelativePosition," "MentalitySimilarity," "SimilarEvent," "AppearanceSimilarity," "Environment," and "Layout"—each have 90 instances, with percentages ranging from 8.77% to 8.87%. The segments are color-coded and labeled with their respective names, counts, and percentages, and the chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of each category in the dataset.
